pages.title: Miles Tails Prower Smiling with His Two Fluffy Tails Spread Behind Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Miles Tails Prower smiles with his two fluffy tails spread behind him in this printable coloring page, giving a thumbs-up while extending his other gloved hand. His pointed ears and swept hair frame his face. The plain background keeps attention on the large tail sections, rounded shoes, chest patch, and smaller finger and cuff outlines.

pages.title: Tails Flying with His Twin Tails Spinning Like Propellers Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails flies with his twin tails spinning like propellers in this printable coloring page, hovering between two small clouds with his arms extended and feet lifted. Curved motion lines encircle the sweeping tails overhead. Broad fur and shoe shapes dominate the coloring sheet, with narrower sections inside the ears, glove cuffs, and tail tips.

pages.title: Classic Tails Standing Beside a Star Checkpoint Post Coloring Page
pages.description: Classic Tails stands beside a star checkpoint post in this printable coloring page, gripping its shaft with one hand while raising the other in a thumbs-up. His two tails curve behind him. The star emblem and stacked circular base offer clear geometric sections alongside his broad shoes, rounded gloves, and pointed patches of tail fur.

pages.title: Sonic and Tails Running Through Green Hill Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Tails run through Green Hill Zone in this printable coloring page, smiling as they lift their knees and swing their gloved fists past a grassy cliff. A palm tree rises from its checkerboard face. Their large shoe soles fill the foreground, while grass tufts, palm fronds, and cliff squares provide smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: Tails Jumping to Collect a Trail of Golden Rings Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails jumps to collect a trail of golden rings in this printable coloring page, reaching upward with an open glove while his twin tails fan behind his bent legs. Five outlined rings arc above him. Motion marks, small clouds, and grassy ledges frame the leap, leaving broad sections across his fur, gloves, and shoes.

pages.title: Tails Holding a Chaos Emerald in His Gloved Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails holds a Chaos Emerald in his gloved hands in this printable coloring page, presenting the large faceted gem beneath his smiling face and widely spread twin tails. His rounded shoes form a steady base. Triangular gemstone facets add smaller geometric areas within the broad outlines of his gloves, chest patch, ears, and tail tips.

pages.title: Tails Wearing Mechanic Goggles and Holding a Wrench Coloring Page
pages.description: Wearing mechanic goggles, Tails holds a wrench in this printable coloring page, standing in a workshop with his twin tails raised beside a riveted support beam and tool drawers. The goggles rest above his eyes. Circular lenses, wrench openings, and floor fasteners add small geometric details around the larger gloves, shoes, and pointed fur sections.

pages.title: Super Tails Flying with Four Super Flickies From Sonic 3 and Knuckles Coloring Page
pages.description: Super Tails flies with four Super Flickies from Sonic 3 and Knuckles in this printable coloring page, spreading both hands as the birds circle his floating figure. Star-shaped sparkles and curved motion marks fill the gaps. The four small birds offer repeated feather and beak shapes around the broader sections of Tails's fur, gloves, and shoes.

pages.title: Movie Tails Stepping Through a Golden Ring Portal Onto a Grassy Cliff Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Tails steps through a golden ring portal onto a grassy cliff in this printable coloring page, extending one open hand as his large shoe reaches the ledge. His twin tails remain within the ring. Grass tufts, rock cracks, distant cliffs, and a few small clouds add finer outlines around the broad portal band and central figure.

pages.title: Tails Doll Hovering with His Gemstone-tipped Antenna Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails Doll hovers with his gemstone-tipped antenna in this printable coloring page, floating above a simple patch of ground with both gloved hands hanging beside his stitched body. A curved antenna supports the faceted gem. Short seam marks divide his face, ears, torso, and legs, adding small details within the broad tails, shoes, and gloves.

pages.title: Tails.exe Grinning in an Eerie Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails.exe grins in an eerie forest in this printable coloring page, standing between bare twisted trees with a row of pointed teeth and narrowed eyes beneath his swept hair. His twin tails curve behind him. Thin bark lines and grass tufts add detail around the broad body, gloves, and oversized shoes of the central figure.

pages.title: Tails Hugging Cream the Rabbit While Cheese the Chao Floats Beside Them Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails hugs Cream the Rabbit while Cheese the Chao floats nearby in this printable coloring page, with Cream smiling with closed eyes as her long ears hang beside them. Cheese raises both arms above the pair. Their overlapping gloves and rounded shoes form small sections beneath the larger shapes of Cream's dress, Tails's fur, and twin tails.

pages.title: Tails Facing Shadow the Hedgehog in a Tense Standoff Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails faces Shadow the Hedgehog in a tense standoff in this printable coloring page, with both characters clenching their gloved hands and meeting each other's narrowed gaze. Tails's fluffy tails balance Shadow's swept-back spines. The plain setting leaves their full figures clear, with smaller sections in Shadow's wrist rings and angular hover shoes.

pages.title: Tails Enjoying His Favorite Mint Candies Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails enjoys his favorite mint candies in this printable coloring page, lifting one wrapped sweet toward his smiling mouth while holding an open bag filled with more candies. Several pieces lie beside his shoes. Wrapper twists and curved candy stripes provide small shapes within the broad outlines of his gloves, twin tails, and chest patch.

pages.title: Tails Driving His Whirlwind Racing Car Around a Racetrack Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails drives his Whirlwind racing car around a racetrack in this printable coloring page, gripping the steering wheel with both gloves while his twin tails rise behind the seat. The track bends beyond a low safety fence. Large tires, curved body panels, headlights, and the rear wing create varied sections around the small dashboard and wheel details.

pages.title: Tails Riding His Extreme Gear Hoverboard From Sonic Riders Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails rides his Extreme Gear hoverboard from Sonic Riders in this printable coloring page, bending his knees with both fists extended and goggles resting above his eyes. His twin tails sweep behind him. Motion lines follow the board's pointed nose, while inset panels, shoe straps, and goggle rims provide smaller areas within the broad character shapes.

pages.title: Tails Striking a Checkpoint Bell with His Ring in Tails Skypatrol Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails strikes a checkpoint bell with his ring in this printable coloring page from Tails Skypatrol, flying beside the hanging bell with his twin tails spinning overhead. Small impact marks surround the contact point. The bell's chain and pole frame his extended glove, while distant palm-topped cliffs, clouds, and water lines add background details.

pages.title: Halloween Tails Wearing a Vampire Cape Beside a Carved Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: Halloween Tails wears a vampire cape beside a carved pumpkin in this printable coloring page, resting one glove on its stem beneath a full moon crossed by clouds. A bare tree and pointed fence stand behind him. The cape's wide folds and pumpkin ribs form broad sections around the triangular eyes, round clasp, and small grass tufts.

pages.title: Tails Blowing Out Candles on His Birthday Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails blows out candles on his birthday cake in this printable coloring page, leaning over the table with pursed lips while his twin tails rise beside a cluster of balloons. Three striped candles stand on the cake. Scalloped frosting bands, small toppings, balloon strings, and curtain folds add details around the large cake and character shapes.

pages.title: Free Printable Sonic the Hedgehog Tails Chibi Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows chibi Tails from Sonic the Hedgehog with an open smile, outstretched gloved hands, and both fluffy tails spread beneath him. His large shoe soles face forward in the lively pose. The coloring sheet has broad spaces inside the ears, gloves, and tails, with smaller curved sections around his eyes and muzzle.

pages.title: Tails Sonic the Hedgehog Articulated Paper Doll Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails appears as an articulated paper doll in this printable coloring page, with separate head, body, limb, shoe, and tail pieces arranged across the sheet. Small circular joint markers identify connection points, and stitch-like lines cross several shapes. The coloring sheet keeps generous white space between parts, with clear outlines around Tails' pointed ears and two sweeping tails.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Sitting in Canyon Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Tails sit together on a canyon ledge in this printable coloring page, smiling with their gloved hands on the rock and their shoes dangling. Tails' two bushy tails curl behind him among layered cliffs, small stones, grass tufts, clouds, and a round sun.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Walking in Canyon Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Tails walk through a canyon in this printable coloring page, with Sonic raising an open glove as Tails smiles beside him on the rocky path. Tall layered walls, angular boulders, small pebbles, low bushes, and grass tufts fill the winding passage.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Posing in Ice Cap Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Tails pose in Ice Cap Zone on this printable coloring page, with Sonic giving a thumbs-up and Tails waving beside his two bushy tails. Faceted crystal clusters, snow-capped ledges, a waterfall, and simple clouds add angular and rounded shapes around them.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Standing in Eggman Base Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Tails stand inside Eggman's base in this printable coloring page, with Sonic folding his arms while Tails holds a wrench beside his smiling face. Control panels, gauges, riveted beams, overhead pipes, a conveyor, and an Eggman emblem fill the mechanical interior.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Exploring in Beach Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Tails explore a beach together in this printable coloring page, taking relaxed steps across the sand with their oversized shoes and Tails' twin tails clearly outlined. Leaning palm trees, gentle ocean waves, distant islands, scattered pebbles, and rounded clouds complete the coastal scene.

pages.title: Sonic Tails the Fox Snowy Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Tails the Fox from Sonic standing in a snowy setting, with falling snow dots and his two tails fanned behind him. He holds his gloved hands out beside a fluffy chest tuft. Large shoes, pointed ears, and a simple ground line keep the coloring sheet uncluttered, with broad enclosed spaces across the character.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Thinking In Ravine Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails sits thinking on a rock in a ravine in this printable coloring page, touching his chin beneath a pair of goggles and an empty thought bubble. Winding ripples circle the rock below his two tails, with tall canyon walls and broad clouds behind him.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Running In Obstacle Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails runs through an obstacle course in this printable coloring page, lifting his leading shoe toward the viewer as his two bushy tails trail behind him. Three floating rings rise above a long beam, with low hurdles, rounded bushes, and small stones nearby.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Sitting In Wheat Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails sits smiling in a wheat field in this printable coloring page, wearing goggles on his head with both shoe soles stretched forward and his twin tails beside him. Tall grain heads and narrow leaves form a detailed border beneath simple clouds and distant hills.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Posing On Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails poses on an arched wooden bridge in this printable coloring page, raising one gloved fist as his two tails curve behind his smiling face. Repeating railings, plank lines, round-topped posts, cross-braced supports, distant hills, and two clouds provide details around the central figure.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Watching In Adventure Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails watches the adventure landscape in this printable coloring page, wearing goggles above his forehead as a winding route stretches between rocks and unusual spiral-topped trees. His pointed ears, cheek tufts, and bushy tails fill the foreground beneath snow-tipped mountain peaks inside a rectangular border.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Standing Confidently In Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails stands confidently in town on this printable coloring page, resting both gloved fists at his hips while goggles sit above his smiling face and pointed ears. A cobbled path curves past buildings with arched windows toward a tall clock tower beneath rounded clouds.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Sitting In Ocean Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails sits in the ocean in this printable coloring page, smiling with his shoes and two bushy tails surrounded by wide curling waves and small ripples. Bubbles rise beside him, while a tiny palm-covered island and a smiling sun sit along the distant horizon.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Smiling On Loop Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails smiles with both arms spread on a loop platform in this printable coloring page, standing above a layered circular base with his two tails raised behind him. Four outlined gears surround the platform, adding simple teeth and round centers beside his gloves and shoes.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Standing Confidently In Underground Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails stands confidently in an underground cave in this printable coloring page, wearing goggles and a buckled utility belt with pouches beside his twin bushy tails. A winding stream, crystal clusters, tall rock formations, hanging points, scattered stones, and small floating circles fill the cavern.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Exploring In Machine Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails explores a machine area in this printable coloring page, holding a large wrench while opening his other hand beside his goggles and two bushy tails. Oversized gears, curved pipes, hanging cables, a pressure gauge, and control panels fill the space around his small figure.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Observing In Adventure Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails observes an adventure landscape through binoculars in this printable coloring page, standing beside a stepping-stone path with his two tails curling behind his body. Palm trees flank a tall waterfall beneath rocky cliffs, snowy mountain peaks, broad clouds, and a low sun.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Thinking In Street Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails sits thinking on a city curb in this printable coloring page, touching his chin beneath an empty thought bubble while goggles rest above his pointed ears. Simple block-shaped buildings, rectangular doorways, tall streetlights, and a raised sidewalk frame his shoes and twin tails.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Pointing In Neon City Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic stands beneath a separate Tails portrait in this printable coloring page, with his fists lowered while Tails' pointed ears and fluffy tails spread above him. Tall angular buildings, outlined signs, antennae, and geometric window panels line the city street, adding many narrow sections around the two character faces.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Relaxing Peacefully On A Rainbow Hillside Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails relaxes on a rainbow hillside in this printable coloring page, reclining with half-closed eyes and his hands resting over his shoes between his two bushy tails. Broad rainbow bands curve beneath him, with two flying birds, rounded clouds, and a large sun overhead.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Walking Happily On A Bright Hillside Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails walks happily on a bright hillside in this printable coloring page, smiling as one shoe lifts forward and his two tails rise behind his body. Long grass blades, rounded bushes, smooth slopes, broad clouds, and a straight-rayed sun provide simple landscape shapes around him.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Resting Peacefully On A Sunny Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails rests peacefully on a sunny hill in this printable coloring page, closing his eyes with his head on folded gloves and his two bushy tails curled around him. A large outlined sun and scattered grass tufts complete the small scene against an open background.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Getting Ready To Run In A Sunny Hill Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails gets ready to run in a sunny hill zone in this printable coloring page, crouching low with both fists extended and goggles above his determined eyes. His large shoes and two raised tails fill the foreground among palm trees, grassy slopes, bushes, and a round sun.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Walking Proudly In A Flower Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails walks proudly through a flower field in this printable coloring page, wearing goggles above his forehead as a large shoe steps forward between dense blooms. Rounded petals, oval flower centers, leafy stems, small grass tufts, curved hillside bands, and broad clouds surround his twin tails.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Celebrating Happily In A Grassy Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails celebrates happily in a grassy valley in this printable coloring page, raising both open gloves with an excited smile beneath his goggles and pointed ears. His two bushy tails spread beside him above rolling slopes, scattered grass tufts, rounded bushes, distant trees, and clouds.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Looking Happy Near Rolling Hills Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails looks happy near rolling hills in this printable coloring page, spreading both open gloves as his two large tails frame his smiling face and goggles. Broad clouds, smooth layered slopes, and a partly hidden spiky sun form an open background around his shoes.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Smiling Happily Near A Jungle River Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails smiles beside a jungle river in this printable coloring page, standing on a grassy bank with his hands behind him and both bushy tails raised. Winding water flows past rocks, broad leaves, round flowers, and tall palms that frame the detailed tropical scene.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Running Happily In A Wide Open Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails runs happily through a wide open field in this printable coloring page, lifting his leading shoe toward the viewer while pumping his gloved fists beside his chest. His two tails sweep behind him against a simple horizon of rounded bushes and broad clouds.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Looking Happy In A Colorful Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Tails look happy in a colorful valley in this printable coloring page, with Sonic running ahead while a goggle-wearing Tails lifts both feet behind him. Large flowers, spotted mushrooms, rounded trees, rolling hills, clouds, and a sun fill the framed landscape.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Running Happily Near A Sunny Coastline Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails runs happily near a sunny coastline in this printable coloring page, wearing goggles and a neckerchief while his two tails trail behind his smiling face. Gentle waves follow the curving beach beneath leaning palm trees and a sun with long straight rays.

pages.title: Sonic Tails Looking Happy Near A Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Tails looks happy near a mountain in this printable coloring page, spreading both open hands beside his goggles and twin bushy tails with a broad smile. Snow-tipped peaks and a rising sun provide the simple backdrop, with small grass tufts around his large shoes.
